digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init currently creates an orphan divergent store when ticket branch fetch fails or times out, incorrectly treating network failure as a legitimate first-init condition
_mount_or_create_branch and pending_init_attaches_to_existing must distinguish three states (local branch exists, remote advertises branch, remote unreachable) rather than only checking local refs
when a remote is unreachable or advertises the configured branch but fetch fails, init must return nonzero and create no orphan unless --force-new-store is explicitly supplied

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable remotes as do-not-auto-mount, returning without error while the subsequent strict path reuses the cached probe result and reports the actionable failure
a shared bounded tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote must cache results by resolved repo/remote/branch to limit network cost to one probe per CLI invocation on the unreachable path
